item.title: Harness engineering for Codex agent workflows
item.description:
OpenAI introduces a developer platform primitive for Codex: a harness engineering pattern for long running agent workflow orchestration.

The opening preview covers evals, sandbox permissions, tool use, context engineering, and observability for production coding agents.
